chunks.area: electron/store.js — load-time wipe of spaces + project.spaceId
chunks.rationale: Read first: this is the migration. _readFile always sets spaces: [] and migrateProject deletes spaceId. If the on-disk file still had either, _recoveredOnLoad becomes true so the next save persists the flatten. getSpaces/setSpaces are no-ops that cannot revive rows.
risks: The constructor still calls the debounced save() on recover, not saveNow() — a crash before the first flush would leave the old spaces key on disk, but the next successful load wipes them again.
hadSpaces is computed from the raw parsed file, before migrateProject, so a spaceId-only store still triggers persist.

chunks.rationale: listSpaces always []. addSpace/updateSpace throw 'Spaces have been removed'. removeSpace is a no-op. updateProject ignores spaceId instead of validating it. IPC channels stay so an older renderer does not crash on boot.
risks: An older renderer that still shows the + button will get a thrown add and a project-scope error toast — intended, not a silent no-op.
devCoder.ts still implements in-memory spaces for the web stub; it cannot persist them through this store.

chunks.rationale: buildSidebarSections is gone. Sidebar now maps buildSidebarGroups directly. All space chrome (add, rename, delete, collapse, drag-and-drop onto a space header) is deleted. visibleIds follows groups, no collapsed-space filter.
risks: Project headers are no longer draggable. Nothing else used PROJECT_DRAG_TYPE.
coder.sidebar.collapsedSpaces localStorage keys are orphaned; harmless leftover.
The group-render block kept its old extra indent from the deleted section wrapper — style only.

chunks.rationale: Renderer no longer loads, holds, or edits spaces. Edit project drops the Space <select>. useCoder boot Promise.all no longer waits on spaces.list().
risks: CoderApi.spaces remains on the wire contract; only the hook/UI stopped calling it.

chunks.rationale: electron/test/spaces.test.js is now the retirement contract (wipe + ignore + throw). test/spaces.test.tsx asserts no space chrome. sidebarGroups section suite deleted.
risks: fakeCoder still implements spaces.* so a test can seed leftover rows; the UI simply ignores them (covered by the edit-project test).

chunks.rationale: Incoming from main during update: resolve the chip as started immediately after a successful fork, then startRun. Combined so this merge does not drop the other branch's annotation.
risks: If resolveSuggestion fails after fork, the user still has an idle fork and the chip stays open.
No live visual verification — macOS screen-recording TCC blocked earlier in this thread. Renderer 1197/1197 and electron spaces+services 58/58 pass.
IPC spaces:* channels are still registered. That is deliberate compatibility, not leftover UI.
Sidebar redesign 1/3 (#566) and 2/3 (#567) already shipped on this branch; this is 3/3 plus an update-from-main that also landed suggested-work chips and the site redesign.
